messages:
amy_ceo: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on security/privacy. dropping key points here.

jordan_security: thanks — i'll annotate.

amy_ceo: 1) SOC2 evidence access: can engineering pull bundles directly?

jordan_security: compliance will provide the canonical auditor bundle. teams get read-only exports for their services.

nadia_compliance: i'll publish a short handoff checklist (infra diagrams, access lists, git tags, key rotation notes).

amy_ceo: 2) KMS/BYOQ with HSM attestation? timeline?

jordan_security: BYOK via wrapped keys is supported now. HSM attestation/prototype targeted for Q3, pilot in Q4.

maya_infra: note: Private installs can point to customer KMS today; HSM driver + attestation is separate work.

sam_pm: 3) Audit log exports: can customers stream to S3?

jordan_security: yes for Dedicated/Private; hosted export bundles now and streaming beta for enterprise next quarter. defaults: 90d raw/365d aggregates.

nadia_compliance: reminder: exported logs must include README with retention, encryption, and contact for legal requests.

amy_ceo: assigning owners: jordan -> SOC2 + KMS comms, nadia -> checklist + ISO timeline, maya -> VPC/network docs. sam -> track action items and send follow-up email.

ops_bot: follow-up ticket created #ah-1849991234 assigned to sam_pm, due in 5d.
